pageCoverage.notes: Cover: Lecture51 Introducing the Hardware for the Robot, printed1.
Four outcomes: hardware, actuators/power/structure, AI sensors, hardware–AI performance choices.
Agenda lists structure, actuators, grippers, sensors, compute, power, communications, mappings and fusion.
Sense→think→act diagram. Camera/LiDAR/IMU→CPU/GPU/MCU→motor/servo. Printed4.
Six subsystem boxes: body links/joints/chassis; battery/PSU/wiring; actuators; sensors; MCU/SBC/GPU; ROS/CAN/Wi-Fi. These are not identical protocol layers.

Six material rows: steel5stars heavy low; aluminium4 light medium; CFRP5 verylight high; titanium5 medium veryhigh; plastics2 verylight verylow; silicone flexible light medium. Qualitative not universal mechanical datasheet. Lighter link claim needs same geometry/motion assumptions.

Hydraulic compact high force/direct-drive and peripheral equipment/leaks/friction. Pneumatic compressed-air compressibility/friction. Actual lower cutaway has left downward inlet, right upward outlet and rightward rod; upper hydraulic arrows/rod reversed. Full-size original re-viewed.

Brushed motor stationary brushes contact rotating commutator feeding rotor windings; torque proportional current; heating limitation. Electric/fluid power-to-weight generalization is illustrative, not universal sizing result.

BLDC stator windings and rotating magnet, brush-wear/cooling advantages; internal angle sensor is one implementation. Historical AC-use claim and blanket low-stepper-torque claim require modern qualification.
Five gripper kinds, task examples, action-space relation. Magnetic metal wording needs suitable magnetism; vacuum seal and hygiene/load constraints not universal guarantees.
Proprio encoder/IMU/current/F-T versus extero RGB/depth/LiDAR/ultrasound/tactile. F-T internal classification is a source convention; interaction is external too.
Table encoder1–10kHz, RGBD30–90fps, LiDAR10–20Hz, IMU100–1000Hz with outputs and tasks. Ranges illustrative hardware-dependent.
MCU8–240MHz kB <1W classical PID/low-level; Pi4 example1.8GHz4GB5W; Nano128CUDA4GB5–10W. AI heading does not make PID learned. Specs/source examples not timeless guarantees.
AGX Orin2048CUDA64GB275TOPS15–60W; FPGA deterministic parallel5–20W; cloud+5G called unlimited, an overstatement. TOPS needs precision/sparsity and workload context.

Battery table LiPo150–250Wh/kg upto100C300–500cycles; LiIon100–200,1–3C,500–1000; NiMH60–120,5–10C,500; leadacid30–50,low,200–300. Chemistry/package rows and ratings are illustrative. BMS named in title, no circuit/protection details.
Two5W motors+10W compute+5W sensors=25W.2.5Ah11.1V=27.75Wh; ideal66.6minutes. No losses/reserve/variableload included.
UART115kbps–10Mbps GPS/debug/LiDAR; I2C100kbps–1Mbps IMU/ToF/OLED; CAN1Mbpsjoint/ECU. Ranges are selected examples; I2C higher modes and CANFD exist.
EtherCAT100Mbps deterministic cobotcontrol; ROS2/DDS Wi-Fi networkdependent sensor→planner→driver. Middleware is not Wi-Fi-only and does not itself guarantee totaldeadline.

Six hardware-AI mappings. q[.3,-.1,1.2]rad; PWM75%→speed75% is not universal; +10stablegraspreward is designed; inference8ms; ±.088°→Gaussian sigma.001 unsupported without distribution; policy100Hz→IMU>=200Hz not universal Nyquist derivation. Full-size original re-viewed.

Fusion motivations redundancy/accuracy/robustness/completeness; encoder/F-T/IMU/vision/tactile; Kalman/EKF/particle/CNN-LSTM/Bayesian list. Accuracy/fault tolerance require calibration/error models, not automatic. No inverse-variance equation supplied on page.

Mobile palette LiDAR/odometry/IMU/GNSS/stereoRGBD/ultrasonicIR. Pipeline raw→filter/calibrate/sync→features→EKF/graphSLAM estimation/loopclosure→map+pose. 360degree LiDAR example not every sensor; graph/EKF variants not identical algorithms.
Summary structureDOF/workspace,6DOF mostflexible qualification; motors/servoangle/PWM; gripperactionspace,F-Tcompliantcontrol; sensors. Footer overlaps last sensor bullet but actual words legible.
Compute/power latency and hardwareAI summary. Hardware imperfections contribute sim-to-real gap but are not exclusive explanation.
Three bibliographic references only, no new examinable formula.
Thank-you only.

remainingBoundedGaps.finding: Material rows, simple torque scaling and gripper names are covered separately, but no bounded hardware co-design question combines structural inertia, actuator capability and terminal-tool task constraints. Brushless cooling versus electronic commutation is not substantively challenged.
remainingBoundedGaps.remedy: Replace weak matching/recall with a constrained source-based design scenario using only declared candidate properties. Require a coherent material/actuator/gripper combination, comparable inertia/load assumptions, action-dimension versus task-capability tradeoff, and the actual brush-wear/cooling/electronic-commutation distinction. Do not invent safety guarantees or grade-specific strength data.

remainingBoundedGaps.finding: Separate runtime, UART, camera-bandwidth and serial-loop calculations exist, but no candidate must simultaneously satisfy energy, data-rate and end-to-end timing constraints. This misses the lecture learning outcome of connecting hardware choices to AI performance.
remainingBoundedGaps.remedy: Add one integrated, explicitly parameterized compute/power/link selection exercise. Require full motor+sensor+compute power, usable battery energy, payload/framing units and serial sensing/inference/command timing, distinguishing low-level MCU from inference compute. Supply candidate measurements instead of deriving latency from TOPS; preserve network/power uncertainty.

remainingBoundedGaps.finding: Fusion methods and individual sensor roles are recalled; scalar weighting is isolated. No bounded failure-aware mobile-palette/pipeline scenario tests complementary sensing when GNSS is unavailable, odometry drifts/slips, vision is occluded or timestamps disagree. Ultrasonic/IR close-range roles remain only peripheral distractors.
remainingBoundedGaps.remedy: Add a source-bounded pipeline/fault scenario with explicit available measurements and error/timestamp assumptions. Ask which preprocessing, complementary sensors and valid loop-closure evidence are justified; include near-range ultrasound/IR versus global/relative pose roles. A declared independent scalar weighting plus a shared-bias or stale-sample variant may exercise robustness without inventing an unsourced full EKF derivation.

conceptLedger: 76 one-to-one question/concept records are not independent evidence of exhaustive coverage. All20 substantive pages are cited. Consolidate connected concepts and distinguish factual, applied, comparative and failure angles; three integrated gaps remain.
difficultyFinding: Existing simple items mostly have honest easy labels and eight multi-step numerical items are medium. No hard or extremely-tricky substantive angle or multiselect is present; add genuine synthesis rather than relabeling recall.
sourceQualifications: Keep all observed qualifications: qualitative material/rate/battery/spec tables, actuator versus full-system power density, sensored/sensorless and historical AC/stepper claims, gripper suitability and action-space limits, F/T source classification, PID not inherently ML, peakTOPS/cloud limits, protocol variants/layers, duty-speed/noise/sampling shortcuts, six-component wrench/fusion limitations, SLAM/FOV/global-consistency limits, workspace/singularity and sim-to-real causes. BMS is a heading only: do not invent a missing BMS lecture or claim unsupported circuit coverage.
runtime: Default interpreter and standard library only; independently reconstructed numerical examples. The lecture has no executable program. No package, model, corpus or external runtime used; restricted L48 temporary environment not used.
formulaResource: Numerical families have structured variables/units/assumptions. Q056 needs the specific distribution-scope repair; Q065 needs the promised pre-answer rule. Keep separate weekly formulas bound to source or explicit added models, not empirical hardware guarantees.
answerPosition: Stored IDs follow a cyclic key pattern, but existing central presentation remediation uses an answer-independent question-seeded order. Do not change stable option IDs merely to mask author order; no new user-facing answer-position claim made.
reviewerCorrection: The frozen observation for physical1598 incorrectly said printed4. Actual source has no visible footer; author citation already correctly records this. Preserve the original evidence and this correction.
